Replacement path: RowDefinitionSettingsPanel.assessReplacement calls client.assessRowChange with mode REPLACE and current identity, calls client.preview with candidate receipt/output (no explicit limit), then applyReplacement rechecks current assessment and calls the same Builder callback APPLY_TABLE_ROOT_REBASE.

The Preview row limit is the finite union 25|50|100|500|1000.
Recompile is rendered only for stale or repair reconciliation with tables and no incomplete root.

Reconcile itself has at most three attempts.

cardinality.unit: active row-definition proposal for selected table

constraints.claim: Row choices are accepted only when response outputId and snapshotToken match the selected table and catalog snapshot.
A proposal is applied only when its output, snapshot, draft version and digest still match the current table; comparison must be AVAILABLE and proposalId present.

Fresh row-definition proposal exposes Cancel and Apply row definition. Cancel aborts pending preview and clears local proposal; apply sends APPLY_ROW_DEFINITION_PROPOSAL through the normal server command path. No reject control is present.

Changing row shape or policy debounces proposal submission by 300 ms; the proposal response carries the row-membership comparison used for review, so this flow does not issue a separate /preview request.

requests.condition: settings opened for selected table
selection change waits 300 ms; current settings are loaded
proposal fresh/current, comparison AVAILABLE, proposalId present, actions enabled

prose.route_action: From the mounted starting-record settings, load row-definition choices for the selected output and snapshot. Selecting a row shape or policy schedules a proposal; review its membership comparison and then Apply row definition or Cancel.
prose.request_constructor: RowDefinitionSettingsPanel.openSettings calls client.listRowDefinitionChoices. Shape and policy changes call schedulePreview, which waits 300 ms before propose; propose calls client.proposeRowDefinition with current output/snapshot/draft identity and the selection. The proposal comparison is the review preview. Apply rechecks current identity and calls onApply(proposalId), which BuilderWorkspace sends as APPLY_ROW_DEFINITION_PROPOSAL through applyCommandsWithResult.
gates: Choices are accepted only for the current output and snapshot; stale settings responses are ignored.
Apply requires a fresh proposal whose output, snapshot, draft version and digest match current state, comparison status AVAILABLE, proposalId present, and actions enabled.
Changing selection cancels the prior proposal timer/request; Cancel closes settings and clears the local proposal without changing the saved draft.
prose.finite_state_input_bounds: Settings state is closed|loading|editing|error. Proposal state is none|proposing|fresh|stale|failed|applying. Selection kind is RECORDS|FIELD_GROUP|EXPLICIT_GROUP|EXPANDED; missing-key, empty-collection and unassigned-member policies each use their finite enum in domain.finite_enum_values. At most one active proposal is reviewed for the selected output.
transition_preview_invariants: Selection changes wait 300 ms and then issue a row-definition proposal; no standalone /preview request is made by this flow.
The proposal response supplies the membership comparison; it does not change the server-saved draft until APPLY_ROW_DEFINITION_PROPOSAL succeeds.
Stale or unavailable comparison state cannot be applied; the result is reported as stale/failed and leaves the draft unchanged.
known_assumptions: The proposal comparison is the UI review preview for row-definition changes; the source has no separate row-definition preview endpoint call.
The choice and proposal routes are supported by mounted RowDefinitionSettingsPanel, and are not inferred from backend enum declarations.
